items.title: The Shift to cgroup v2 in Kubernetes: What You Need to Know
items.blurb: In Linux, cgroups (control groups) are a kernel feature used for managing system resources.

items.title: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap
items.blurb: Memory is often the first hard limit a Kubernetes cluster hits. Nodes run out of RAM long before they run out of CPU, and the new wave of agentic AI workloads makes this worse.

items.title: Spotlight on SIG Apps
items.blurb: As Kubernetes adoption has grown, the conversation has shifted beyond running containers to managing increasingly complex application lifecycles.

items.title: OpenTelemetry Makes Kubernetes Attributes Processor Stable as Observability Schema Matures
items.blurb: OpenTelemetry has promoted its Kubernetes Attributes Processor to v1.0.0, marking a significant step in making Kubernetes telemetry more predictable and stable across observability pipelines. By Craig Risi

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Tracking When a PersistentVolumeClaim Was Last Used (Beta)
items.blurb: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime feature gate to Beta (enabled by default).

items.title: Istio 1.31 Adds Agentgateway Waypoints and Moves Release Artifacts off Google Cloud
items.blurb: Istio 1.31 adds agentgateway waypoints in ambient mode, with a canary configuration fix included in 1.31.1.
